## Objectives

- Defeat 60 [Tusker](../monsters/tusker.md)
- Defeat 1 Elite Disturbance-touched boar ([Hedge Boar](../monsters/hedge_boar.md), [Rooting Piglet](../monsters/rooting_piglet.md), [Tusker](../monsters/tusker.md))
